in_arabic.name: دماء
in_arabic.meaning: دم (blood) or وجهة من الرحمة (compassionate, merciful)
in_arabic.long_meaning: The name Damaa comes from the Arabic word 'dam', which means 'blood' or 'wound' in its various meanings. The name can be interpreted as 'healing', 'compassionate', or 'protector', as it refers to the idea of soothing, healing, or shielding someone from harm.
